review.notes: Checked the final 15 hat definitions twice against authoritative English source. Preserved boolean/hide flags, empty fields, tailoring/order IDs, slash layouts, and duplicated display-name fields exactly in structure. Names and descriptions received two editorial passes for concise idiomatic Greek, consistent pan terminology, clear cultural hat references, source humor, and current Mystery Box, Junimo, Governor, and Infinity glossary terms.
